podcast.body: Paul McCartney's number one hit from 1965, a song he both penned and recorded himself. "Yesterday" has reportedly been covered more than 2200 times, making it one of the most covered songs in musical history. "The 1965 number 1 hit yesterday penned and recorded by Paul McCartney."

podcast.body: This was Paul McCartney's chart-topping Beatles hit, subtly referenced by John Lennon in his 1970 song "God" as a veiled diss. "Lennon also snuck in the word yesterday into the lyrics, suggesting that he was also calling out Paul McCartney, referencing Paul's chart-topping Beatles hit."
